objective: Largest integrated Part I improvement pass so far: make the game feel like one coherent offline adventure rather than disconnected feature demos.

pillars.goal: Movement, camera, interaction, combat and recovery feel coherent.
Every meaningful character behaves with identity, knowledge, memory, relationships, emotion and regional awareness.
Regions feel populated and emotionally distinct through inhabitants, fauna, activity, atmosphere and discoveries.
Player lives the Fellowship film chronology with optional exploration between immutable anchors.
Camera, motion, sound, lighting, subtitles and scene transitions support cinematic play without replacing agency.
All shipped intelligence and play remain functional with network disconnected.
Developers catch reproducible regressions before owner play sessions.

merge_rule: Do not merge PR #53 into develop until its current head passes Pre-Unreal and the full UE4.27 validation chain.
supersession_rule: PR #53 is the active continuation of PR #52. Avoid parallel feature commits on PR #52.
